scripts.build:foundations: bun run --filter '@jhomra21/mesurer-core' build && bun run --filter '@jhomra21/mesurer-dom' build
scripts.build: bun run build:foundations && bun run --filter '@jhomra21/mesurer-solid' build && bun run --filter '@jhomra21/mesurer' build
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:foundations && bun run --filter '@jhomra21/mesurer-solid' typecheck && bun run --filter 'mesurer-solid-example' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@jhomra21/mesurer-core' test && bun run --filter '@jhomra21/mesurer-dom' test && bun run --filter '@jhomra21/mesurer-solid' test
scripts.dev: bun run build:foundations && bun run --filter '@jhomra21/mesurer-solid' styles && bun run --filter 'mesurer-solid-example' dev
